svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 03/12 Double-Decker Bus (Rare)
svg.desc: A red double-decker rolls down a shady Davis street. Ride up top and wave at the bikes. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
